page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn9gc.8xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server instance built on the x86_64 architecture and managed via the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated physical cores powered by an AMD EPYC 9A75 processor with a base clock speed of 3.3 GHz. The system is equipped with 192.0 GB of RAM, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 6.0 GB per physical core.

Acceleration is provided by a single NVIDIA Blackwell GPU with 72 GB of dedicated VRAM. The instance does not include local storage, requiring all data persistence to be handled by network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 32 Gbps.

From a qualitative perspective, this instance offers high resource density by pairing dedicated AMD EPYC processing cores with next-generation NVIDIA Blackwell GPU architecture. This configuration is optimized for parallel processing workloads, including machine learning training, deep learning inference, high-performance computing, and complex data analytics.
